bio.text: Dave Beckwith won the Republican nomination for Virginia's 10th Congressional District in the August 4, 2026 primary and will face Democratic Rep. Suhas Subramanyam in November.
He served 30 years in the U.S. Air Force, rising to deputy assistant secretary of defense, and worked for the contractors Orbital ATK and SAIC after retiring from the Air Force.
Beckwith lives in Loudoun County, where InsideNoVa reports he has been a resident for 17 years, and ran unsuccessfully in the 2022 Republican primary for the same district.
